purpose: Decide the single permitted zero-cycle physical repair after M479 lane-local wires collapsed to the exact M477 mapped netlist.

identity_guard.required_structure: One root drives 12 preserved branch buffers; every branch drives eight row and eight psum leaf buffers; no registered staging is allowed.

required_vcs_before_dc: The full M479 golden-model regression passes unchanged after only DUT/top renaming.
The stale RAW/backpressure targeted regression passes unchanged.
No cycle, transaction, numeric, protocol, reset, overflow, or SVA behavior changes are admitted.
pass_gate: Elaborated and mapped design identity is exactly the required M498 top.
The explicit branch and leaf buffer structure survives synthesis and no registered enable staging exists.
Setup and hold path slack are nonnegative.
The max-delay, min-delay, max-capacitance, max-transition, and max-fanout reports are all clean.
Total standard-cell area is no more than 44779.2 um2.
An independent receipt-blind hammer confirms topology, values, and identity.
failure_rule: This is the final M479-family physical retry. Any functional mismatch, wrong top, lost buffer tree, design-rule violation, negative slack, area above 44779.2 um2, missing report, or identity ambiguity permanently closes the Conv dual-slot physical line. Constraints may not be relaxed.
